purpose: Small real-media SearchAgent prototype corpus; metadata search plus original-file retrieval, not production children-content certification
metadata_provenance_policy: Source page text is CC BY-SA 4.0 unless specified; Wikimedia structured file data is CC0. Preserve provenance/attribution and flag derived Korean fields.
scope_notes: 8 real Commons videos. Only one small file downloaded and validated with ffprobe; other 7 original URLs verified in live source DOM, not downloaded or playback-tested.
No synthetic transcript, subtitle, age range, popularity or pedagogical score. Use null/unknown, never fill with fiction.
Corpus is skewed to nature/space. It is not a catalog of licensed Korean children shows. Dinosaur/numbers coverage remains open rather than adding weak candidates.
Public source discovery and indexing do not establish all downstream commercial/public distribution rights. Review item-level terms and final product use.

download_guidance.on_error: Record failure and continue; never fabricate a local file or treat an HTML error as video. Respect site limits; do not evade bot or access controls.
download_guidance.validation: Check MIME/magic and ffprobe; compute SHA-256. Preserve original source data plus download timestamp.

research_alternatives.assessment: Accessible structured reference data and per-dataset licenses; no suitable playable child-focused corpus verified in this pass. Example country-codes CSV has ODC-PDDL-1.0 but explicitly warns to review upstream restrictions for public/commercial use. Not used as media source.

excluded_candidates.reason: CC BY 4.0 uploader declaration but derivative source components listed; prioritised simpler provenance.
CC BY-SA uploader declaration, but video of an animatronic sculpture. Underlying depicted-work rights not established; not automatically included.
Mixed music credits and source components need additional licensing verification.

repository_instructions: Keep source_manifest.json with its CC BY-SA 4.0 provenance notice in a data/ directory; do not imply that the repository code license overrides this metadata license or any media license.
Media files remain under their individual license_id and license_url. Include per-item attribution in a NOTICE or ATTRIBUTIONS file and preserve source URLs.
Korean translations and descriptions are derived metadata, not official localized titles, subtitles, transcripts, pedagogical tags or age ratings. Keep those provenance fields.
For a public build, retain metadata attribution/source/license/change notices. Store downloaded media outside git, and do not redistribute it under the code license.
